entries.794f5922f17803c3: A segment that sells foods such as egg-processed products including tamagoyaki (Japanese rolled omelet), processed vegetable products including seasoned kanpyo (dried gourd strips) and shiitake mushrooms used as fillings for maki sushi (rolled sushi), and fish paste products including crab-flavored kamaboko, to customers that handle nakashoku (buying prepared food to eat at home or elsewhere), such as supermarkets and convenience stores. In addition to products made at its own factories, it also sells goods such as its own planned-brand products purchased from other companies, ambient foods, and frozen and chilled foods. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥46,960 million (down 0.1% from the previous fiscal year) and segment profit was ¥2,564 million (down 29.8%). The securities report cites as reasons for the decline in profit a higher manufacturing cost ratio due to egg prices, the main raw material, remaining at a high level and a decrease in production of maki sushi fillings, as well as increases in personnel and logistics costs. Exports overseas exceeded the previous fiscal year.
